queries.name: gate3db_pago_cxp_columns_full
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,COLUMNPROPERTY(c.object_id,c.name,'IsComputed') AS is_computed,dc.name AS default_name,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: gate3db_pago_cxp_keys_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.type_desc,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,i.has_filter,i.filter_definition,ic.key_ordinal,ic.is_included_column,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: gate3db_pago_cxp_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS constraint_name,o.type_desc,cc.definition AS check_definition FROM sys.objects o LEFT JOIN sys.check_constraints cc ON cc.object_id=o.object_id WHERE o.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND o.type IN ('PK','UQ','C','D','F') ORDER BY o.type,o.name

queries.name: gate3db_pago_cxp_foreign_keys_all
queries.sql: SELECT fk.name AS fk_name,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_schema,OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.delete_referential_action_desc,fk.update_referential_action_desc FROM sys.foreign_keys fk INNER JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id INNER JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id INNER JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE fk.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') OR fk.referenced_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY parent_schema,parent_table,fk.name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: gate3db_pc_id_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,c.is_identity,COLUMNPROPERTY(c.object_id,c.name,'IsComputed') AS is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition,ic.seed_value,ic.increment_value FROM sys.columns c LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id LEFT JOIN sys.identity_columns ic ON ic.object_id=c.object_id AND ic.column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND c.name=N'Pc_ID'

queries.name: gate3db_pc_id_references_modules
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 200 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' AND sm.definition LIKE N'%Pc_ID%' ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name

queries.name: gate3db_pago_cxp_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS trigger_name,t.is_disabled,t.is_instead_of_trigger,sm.definition FROM sys.triggers t LEFT JOIN sys.sql_modules sm ON sm.object_id=t.object_id WHERE t.parent_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY t.name

queries.name: gate3db_child_tables_schema
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(c.object_id) AS table_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,ty.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto')) ORDER BY table_name,c.column_id

queries.name: gate3db_child_tables_keys
queries.sql: SELECT OBJECT_NAME(i.object_id) AS table_name,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id IN (OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante'),OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto')) ORDER BY table_name,i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: gate3db_existing_shape_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pagos,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT Cxp_Folio) AS cxp_distintas,COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT Pc_ID) AS pc_id_distintos,SUM(CASE WHEN Pc_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pc_id_nulls,SUM(CASE WHEN Cxp_Folio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cxp_folio_nulls FROM dbo.Pago_CXP

queries.name: gate3db_child_presence_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos_total,SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante c WHERE c.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND c.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pagos_con_comprobante,SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto i WHERE i.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND i.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pagos_con_impuesto FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p

queries.name: gate3db_candidate_poliza_dependencies
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 300 OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_schema,OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) AS referencing_object,o.type_desc,d.referenced_schema_name,d.referenced_entity_name FROM sys.sql_expression_dependencies d LEFT JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=d.referencing_id WHERE (d.referenced_entity_name=N'Pago_CXP' AND (OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) LIKE N'%Poliza%' OR OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) LIKE N'%Conta%')) OR (OBJECT_NAME(d.referencing_id) LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' AND (d.referenced_entity_name LIKE N'%Poliza%' OR d.referenced_entity_name LIKE N'%Conta%')) ORDER BY referencing_schema,referencing_object,d.referenced_entity_name

queries.name: gate3db_poliza_module_links
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc,sm.definition FROM sys.sql_modules sm INNER JOIN sys.objects o ON o.object_id=sm.object_id INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE sm.definition LIKE N'%Pago_CXP%' AND (sm.definition LIKE N'%Poliza%' OR sm.definition LIKE N'%Conta%') ORDER BY o.type_desc,s.name,o.name
